6
➢ How do I read this sheet?

7
Team Compositions

8
➢ Teams are simply arranged based on Trekker release order.
➢ The first Trekker listed in each team composition is always considered the Main Slot Trekker.
➢ The second Trekker is usually the primary Support Slot Trekker.
➢ The remaining Trekkers are candidates for the final Support Slot, listed in order of their effectiveness for the team.
➢ Trekkers with universal buff effect will not be included unless they offer exceptional value as an alternative option. This is done to reduce the clutter with how much team compositions there are.

*Exception:
- Some team compositions require both Support Slot Trekkers as mandatory picks. In these cases, only the last listed Trekker is flexible and may be swapped out if they are needed for another team.

9
Main Discs

10
Main Disc priorities are determined by overall team utility with these specific Crescendo criteria in mind:

• C1 for Limited, Standard, and Finale Echoing Discs
• C6 for Cataclysm and Event Discs

About Support Discs
You will usually choose Discs that provide the highest relevant stat for the team. Of course, it is best if it also matches the note requirements of your Main Discs but only think of this when we have more Disc options.

Typically, the stats you are looking for are:
• Base ATK
• Elemental DMG%
• AA/Skill DMG%

11
Emblems

12
➢ All emblem affixes are based on the highest rarity.
➢ Emblem affixes with GREEN background indicate that they are the best emblem affix to go for in that slot.
➢ Affixes are ordered by priority from most important (top) to least important (bottom).
➢ Having an Elemental PEN stat of any rarity for your DPS is always better than having none, but do not lock PEN below Gold or Rainbow rarity.

13
Potentials

14
➢ The recommendations are based on maxed out Monolith Research and Ascension Difficulty 8.
➢ All Potentials are arranged based on acquisition and level upgrade priority.
➢ Level 1: Safe to not upgrade past the base level
➢ Level 1+: Upgrade the Potential as much as you can if possible
➢ Level 6: Always upgrade the Potential to its maximum level

*For specific questions, go to the #help-and-advice channel of Stella Sora Official server.

Teresa takes on the Main slot as a support role of this team as she is able to provide ample amounts of ATK% buffs and Aqua DMG Taken debuffs to enemies that are hit by her Main Skill.

★ Key Notes:
• In order
• Casting another Main Skill requires at least 0.3s of delay in order to take advantage of Stream: True Charged Strike's effects.

• Both Cordiality and Muddy Engulf will only activate if you hit the enemy.
• Magic Sword Siphoning is primarily a QoL potential that helps in making her buff and debuff uptimes be more consistent.

Upgrading Limpid Stream (Main Skill) allows Teresa's Surging Shield to absorb damage better.

This upgrade is not mandatory. Only do it if you find yourself struggling to survive.

Suntide Willow (5★ Excl.) | 1/1/1+/1+ (Support Skill > Ultimate)

119

Suntide Willow is a direct upgrade to Teresa as the core support of the team. The obvious upgrade is the significantly larger Support Skill radius for your Main Trekker to move around. Additionally, her skill can easily maintain a permanent uptime which keeps her buffs (and Azure Embrace from Chitose) active at all times.

On a different note, she is usable outside of Aqua as some of her buffing Potentials do not have an element restriction.

★ Key Notes:
• Rhythm Surge and Prismatic Bubbles provides a total of 30% Crit Rate buff for the team.
• Engulfing Tide expands her skill's radius further while giving Aqua DMG buff for the team.
• Marine Justice inflicts a good amount of Aqua DMG Taken debuff.
• Receding Echoes provides Crit DMG buff for the team.
• Balmy Surf provides DEF PEN buff based on the number of Aqua Trekkers in the team.

Prioritize upgrading Frolic in the Sea (Support Skill) first and Beach Warning (Ultimate) next since her Support Skill gives more buffs than her Ultimate.

Unfortunately, the buff scaling for both skills is a bit underwhelming compared to other Trekkers. Additionally, none of her Potentials for this team scale based on Support Skill level. Therefore, you can comfortably stop at Level 7 if you're low on resources.

*As of Patch 1.9, Ice Vortex has been changed to only stack one time per enemy instead of three. So this build is not as good as it was pre-patch.

Freesia's DPS build revolves around the Localized Snowfall potential. This potential enables her Auto Attacks to have a 30% chance to spawn Ice Flowers within 6s after using her Support Skill in Berserk state.

★ Key Notes:
• Ice Vortex provides a significant amount of Crit DMG buff that scales dynamically based on the number of enemies hit on the field (up to 1460/2120% at Lv 6/9 at 20 stacks).
• Penetrating Chill and Winter's Grip stacks up faster when she is near the enemy.
• Blessing of Faith is only taken for its 3s Berserk extension effect.
• Power of Redemption is only taken if you have a surplus for potentials since she is not able to fully utilize it.

Freesia's damage output is fully reliant on Frost Bloom (Support Skill) since this is where the hidden scaling of Localized Snowfall depends on so make sure to upgrade it as much as you can.
